items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: That was Rex Stewart on the last day.

ctx.x: What was the drummer hitting there? Did you hear that stuff?
Yeah. Well, that happened to be me on drugs, but I don't know. I don't remember what I was hitting. Try to think what I was hitting on then. That was Rex Stewart on the last day. Oh, yeah?
I think it could have been Red Allen to me.
